SELECT /* getAdminAuthList */ P.ADMN_NUMB , P.ADMN_IDXX , P.ADMN_NAME , P.AUTH_CODE , P.AUTH_NAME , P.DEPT_CODE FROM ( SELECT R.ADMN_NUMB , R.ADMN_IDXX , R.ADMN_NAME , R.AUTH_CODE , R.AUTH_NAME , R.DEPT_CODE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.ADMN_NUMB) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT A.ADMN_NUMB , A.ADMN_IDXX , A.ADMN_NAME , A.AUTH_CODE , G.AUTH_NAME , A.DEPT_CODE FROM TM_ADMINX A LEFT JOIN TM_AUTHXM G ON G.AUTH_CODE = A.AUTH_CODE WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY A.ADMN_NUMB ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getAdminAuthListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_ADMINX A WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT /* getAdminCount */ COUNT(*) FROM TM_ADMINX WHERE ADMN_NUMB = #{admnNumb}
